title: Reflexiones sobre la verdadera arte de escribir
author: Domingo María de Servidori (c.1724–1790)
holder: Biblioteca de la Universidad de Sevilla (Internet Archive A212107); one plate of the Láminas at the Metropolitan Museum of Art (356985)

rights.statement: Sevilla copy: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (licenseurl on the Internet Archive record). Met object 356985: Open Access, isPublicDomain true.
rights.notes: Checked, not traced: the Sevilla copy is the text volume only (324 leaves, no plates); the Met has one text plate (Lám. 98, engraved by Francisco Asensio, 1784), used to compare the bastarda's movement. The research's BIVALDI copy timed out repeatedly.
